messages:
Maya K: Quick heads-up — final onsite loop for candidate A in ~2h. Two quick asks: debrief note-owner and rubric clarifications. Who's taking notes? :wave:
Samir Patel: I can do notes for the first two interviews, but I have a conflict at 3:30 so someone else needs to finish debrief capture.
Priya: I can stay and finish. I'll also post scores in Greenhouse.
Jordan: I can cover the 3:30-4:00 slot if needed. FYI I want to remind folks to use the standard rubric (link below) — we had some variance last week.
Maya K: Thanks. @People Ops Bot can you drop the debrief form + rubric link here?
People Ops Bot: Reminder: please use the canonical debrief form and attach notes. Form: https://redwood.app/debriefs/new?c=XYZ123 Rubric: https://redwood.app/rubrics/eng-interview-v2
Elena: Quick rubric clarification — for "system design" do we mark overall or split front-end vs infra? last time there was confusion.
Samir Patel: Good call. Per rubric v2: mark "system design" overall, then add 1-2 bullet evidence lines under notes for area (frontend/infra).
Maya K: To make it explicit for the panel: snippet to paste into notes so scoring is consistent:
```
System design: 1-5 (rate overall)
Evidence: - scalability: 1-5
          - tradeoffs: short bullet
Product sense: 1-5
Technical depth: 1-5
Recommend: Yes/No/Maybe
```
Priya: Could we add a short anchor for a 3 vs a 4 so reviewers have concrete examples?
Jordan: Yep. Example anchors in the rubric page, but short version: 3 = solves problem with reasonable tradeoffs, needs guidance on edge cases; 4 = clear design, anticipates major edge cases, cost/latency tradeoffs considered.
Maya K: AV/rooms: interview room B has HDMI + Zoom link. @Elena can you confirm recording permission from candidate?
Elena: Candidate ok with recording, signed release in calendar invite.
Samir Patel: Also quick CR ping — the take-home exercise repo was updated, FYI: https://git.redwood.com/takehome. Not relevant for live loop but good to know for debrief.
Priya: I'll start the debrief doc during the first break and paste the scores to Greenhouse right after. Can someone capture 2 quick quote bullets for strengths/risks?
Jordan: I'll capture strengths for interview 1, Samir can add risks for the same slot.
Maya K: One more ops detail — please leave the "recommend" field blank if you're unsure; don't force yes/no. We'll discuss during debrief and consensus-tally.
People Ops Bot: Heads-up: debrief window reminder in 30m. Be in #people-ops for any last-minute swaps.
Maya K: Perfect — thanks all. See you in the loop. :thumbsup:
